snippet.title: Travel to USA
snippet.description:
After an exciting visit to Europe, the Hudson family is back home. But Jennifer met a new friend on the plane, and Mark invited the family to join him on a trip around the United States! Join Mark and the Hudson's on their new adventure, find hidden objects and solve challenging puzzles!

• Travel all across the U.S.
• Visit more than 10 cities
• Over 1000 hidden objects
• Four game modes
